explanation: CompareTab summarises loading as a count, folds more than three failures into one alert with Retry all, scrolls as one column on compact or short viewports, and moves exports into a Download menu (DownloadMenu) offering compareGenesWorkbook Excel, compareGenesCsv through writeCsv with provenance, and chart PNGs. CompareGenesView adds opt-in chartDownloads (per-tile PNG/SVG via compareFigureExport, per-gene PNG), a flow layout and a collapsible summary table; the compare-set view passes neither and is unchanged.
